{{Quote|To galactic north, Republic forces counterattacked, aided by Zabrak military units, winning key victories at Iridonia and Ithor. That prevented the Mandalorians from executing a pincer movement against Coruscant, and allowed the Republic a corridor for reinforcing the Taris front.|From [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] was '''liberated''' by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3963 BBY]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Atlas" /> freeing the planet from the control of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]<ref name="Warfare" /> The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] counterattacked after the [[First battle of Iridonia (Mandalorian Wars)|Mandalorian invasion]] with the support of Zabrak military units,<ref name="Warfare" /> driving the Mandalorians off-planet, but a Mandalorian presence remained in Iridonian society.<ref name="Darkness">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/iridonian|text=Iridonian Darkness|int=Iridonian Darkness}}</ref>
